system.description:
As a Standard Action, you may designate a single Vehicle as the target of a large-scale assault. If you succeed on a DC 15 Knowledge (Tactics) check, all allied Gunners within line of sight deal 1 additional die of damage to the target with each successful ranged attack until the start of your next turn.

This is a Mind-Affecting effect.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Starships of the Galaxy
